threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still check the Tube app as if it's reliable—everyone knows it's just for decoration in these parts.
Last night on the 196, a group argued over whether Jimi or Amy was the true Brixton legend. They settled on the fish and chips at Etta's instead.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When the sound of a street artist's saxophone blended perfectly with the chatter from the Döner stand below my window at midnight.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you find a Frankfurter at 3 AM in a club still dancing while holding a currywurst in one hand. Multitasking at its finest!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a real local by how they navigate BART delays—no panic, just a calm stroll to the nearest taco truck for a snack.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a full tuxedo hop on the 38 Geary like it was a red carpet. Only in SF do you dress up to ride the bus on a Friday night.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think 'Castell de Gràcia' is a sight. It's just a regular building; locals walk past it every day without a second glance.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by the way they constantly stop to take photos of cada balcó. Locals roll their eyes but secretly appreciate the charm.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it a 'corner shop' instead of a 'bodega' and get confused when people refer to the 'fridge' as a 'chiller.'
Caught a glimpse of a guy serenading a traffic cone on the 133 last night. Only in Brixton, right? The late hours bring out the true characters.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I saw a guy juggling flaming torches at Platz der Luftbrücke while waiting for a bus. Only in Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg do you see a kebab shop and a gallery cohabitating in a repurposed water tower, embodying Berlin’s love for creative contrasts.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only a true local will notice that the taco trucks have their own line of BART delays during late-night runs. It's a delicate dance out there.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 14 Mission at rush hour. A guy was juggling while a woman next to him quietly read Kafka. Just another day in the city.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think they're experiencing Gràcia at its best by sticking to Plaça del Sol, but the real charm hides in the narrow alleys where the locals gather.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by the bewildered expressions at the entrance of supermercats when they struggle with the self-checkout machine. It’s a rite of passage here.
